sources.description: shAnalysis' CI fixture set: the commit of the tag fixtures-2026-08 that its ci.yml checks out into tests/test_data (20 files, 11.06 MB; the tag's README is not copied). 19 are listed: those the repository's code reads (6.0.4: test_static.gfc.gz, read by nothing, is carried by the tag but not listed). Fetched by a clone of the private repository with the credentials of the package's own clone (D33).
